experiment.historical_status_preserved: CLOSED / PASS — unchanged by this run
experiment.gap_addressed: cross-executor execution portability was INCONCLUSIVE because the external models exercised in Iteration 2 had no real repository or tool access; this run supplies an external executor that does.

executor.executor_class: external agent session with real Git, shell, file-write and test-runner access (executor sandbox, not the project's own runtime)
executor.identity_evidence: declared by the executor at run time and NOT independently attested; treated as a claim, never as trust (EXP-002 principle: executor identity is optional, trusted evidence provenance is mandatory)
executor.authorization_path: human-directed session: the task was accepted from the human requester inside the frozen IR's declared FAST scope; MPE granted no autonomous authorization (see mpe_governance_observation)

timestamps.interval_covers: preflight, IR verification, triage/governed-entry cross-check, the permitted change, and the R1 gate suite
timestamps.outside_interval: publication (commit, push, pull request) and the R2 post-write confirmation happen after end_utc and are not part of the measured interval

executed_task.ir_objective: Stage 2 status documentation sync for murat-project-engineer
executed_task.deliverable: A verifiable, machine-readable record of one real external-executor run plus its captured tool evidence, with an additive EXP-002 status/evidence note, all inside the IR's allowed path.
executed_task.mapping_to_ir_objective: The frozen IR scopes this task to documentation/status synchronisation inside experiments/exp-002-machine-protocol/. No source of truth outside that path was edited.
explicitly_not_done: no production code, contract, gate registry, CI workflow, dashboard or Router change
no new experiment, service, runtime, daemon, scheduler, workflow engine, database, backend or persistent agent
no change to the Task Packet, the MPE IR schema or any existing production gate
no change to STATUS.md or the dashboard (both remain stale on this point; deliberately out of this run's allowed path)
